GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.reason: Stack exhaustion from deeply nested brace patterns. braces reaches us only through tailwindcss 3 (via chokidar, fast-glob and micromatch), which the lockfile pulls in twice: as a devDependency, and as the peer of tailwindcss-animate, which sits in dependencies but is loaded only by tailwind.config.ts. Both routes run at build time, expanding the static content globs in tailwind.config.ts and the dev server's watch globs; no visitor input reaches braces and none of its code is in the shipped bundle or the image (the Dockerfile copies only frontend/dist). No patched braces exists (3.0.3, from 2024, is the latest); Tailwind 4 drops it (held major, #231).
